row:
Tenerife Animal Sanctuary - sustainable centre for rescued animals in Tenerife, Canary Island, Spain. 

Previously known as Tenerife Horse Rescue

Registered charity (NGO) created by a couple with a dream to help animals in need. Self funded and run by a big community of volunteers.

Rescuing animals and giving them a voice. Horses, cats, dogs, goats, chickens, tortoises, turkeys, ducks, guinea pigs, pigs and more ... All living happily in our little hand built finca. Created around the basis of recycle, reuse and reduce. 

We invite you to join our sustainable and animal full journey and witness honest and raw videos with so much emotion, chaos, animals, knowledge and honesty.

Subscribe and follow us to help save the lives of hundreds of animals in need. By watching our videos you are helping us fund the sanctuary. 

Join the finca family for the ride!

You can also donate via paypal: donations@tenerifehorserescue or visit our website to help futher www.tenerifeanimalsanctuary.org
